audience: people who want an AI to work with their connected email, calendar and contacts through Nylas

useCases.title: Read and summarize recent emails from a sender
useCases.text: The AI lists messages with the available filters and opens single messages, so you get a summary of what a person wants or what arrived today.

useCases.title: Check what is on your calendar this week
useCases.text: The AI lists your calendars and the events in one calendar, and opens an event for details, so you see your meetings.

useCases.title: Find a contact by email or phone
useCases.text: The AI lists contacts with an email or phone filter and opens a single contact for its details.

useCases.title: Write a draft email and leave it unsent
useCases.text: The AI creates a draft email, for example to confirm a meeting. A draft is not sent, and you can list your drafts to review it.

useCases.title: Send an email or create a calendar event
useCases.text: The AI sends a real email from the connected account, or creates a calendar event that may send invites to participants.
